speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for coming in. You mentioned having episodic cough and shortness of breath; to help me understand your condition, how long have these symptoms been occurring?

speaker: Patient
text: 59-year-old female. The patient reports a 1-month history of episodic cough and shortness of breath. The cough is nonproductive and worsens when climbing stairs and at night. She experienced fever, sore throat, and nasal congestion 8 weeks ago.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for the details. Given your history of fever, sore throat, and nasal congestion 8 weeks ago, do you have any known history of asthma or allergies? REQUEST TEST: Chest_X-Ray

speaker: Doctor
text: The normal measurements are noted. Since you mentioned the cough worsens at night and with exertion, do you experience wheezing, chest tightness, or any difficulty breathing when you lie flat? REQUEST IMAGES: Chest_X-Ray

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Episodic cough and shortness of breath. I also have Cough worsens with exertion and at night, History of recent upper respiratory tract infection symptoms such as fever, sore throat, and nasal congestion.

speaker: Doctor
text: I have requested and reviewed your Chest X-ray images. Based on your recent upper respiratory infection and the worsening of your cough at night and with exertion, do you have any history of heart disease or do you currently smoke?

speaker: Patient
text: Past medical history: 10-year history of hypertension, currently managed with enalapril. History of smoking half a pack of cigarettes daily for 16 years. Social history: Smoker, half a pack of cigarettes daily for 16 years.
